text:
alex: Heads-up — main is red just after merge. Post-merge pipeline failing on smoke/integration -> endpoint-load step. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/build/2050001111
ci-bot: [automated] build 2050001111 failed: smoke/integration (endpoint-load). Logs: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` in worker-3.
sana: @alex @matt can one of you take a quick look? this was after matt's PR merged ~10m ago.
matt: grabbing logs now. I touched batching/routing in that PR (PR #4321). I'll bisect if needed. Can someone kick a rerun to check flakiness?
jamie: /rerun 2050001111 — started.
ci-bot: rerun 2050001112 queued by jamie.
ci-bot: rerun 2050001112 started.
ci-bot: rerun 2050001112 finished: failed same test `test_endpoint_load_1000`.
sana: looks deterministic so far. matt — can you bisect between main~5..main?
matt: starting bisect now, pulling commits.
matt: quick update — local reproduce: running smoke/integration with `--workers 4` reproduces OOM. Suspect batch sizing change.
ops-bot: Note: this is affecting the nightly canary and main smoke, but not blocking deploys to dedicated yet. Creating a short incident thread? Discuss in #incidents if we escalate.
matt: bisect narrowed it to commit `abcd123` (kv-cache: reduce prefix eviction). That commit changed how cached KV blocks are retained which increases peak memory for some configs.
alex: if that's the culprit we should revert on main to restore pipeline while we fix the logic. Can you open a revert PR?
matt: opened revert PR #4322 -> revert abcd123. requesting review from @sana and @alex. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: PR 4322 pipeline started.
ci-bot: PR 4322 pipeline passed smoke/integration.
ci-bot: PR 4322 merged (auto-merge). main is now green in post-merge pipeline.
sana: great — thanks for the quick bisect + revert, @matt. Let's follow up with a patch that keeps correct eviction semantics but bounds peak memory.
alex: agreed. Filing a follow-up ticket and assigning to matt. :thumbsup:
jamie: thanks all, closing this thread for now.
